name: Zeronode AI Chat Assistant
author: zeronode

sections.description:
Zeronode AI Chat Assistant puts the AI chat assistant from your Zeronode account on your site. It answers visitors’ questions and, in a WooCommerce store, helps them find products and add them to the cart.

  • Sign in with your Zeronode account using a one-time email code, or skip the sign-in and paste the assistant’s embed key.
  • Your assistants load automatically. Pick one by name.
  • The plugin attaches a site-locked public embed key for you.
  • Adjust basic appearance (title, brand colour, picture, corners, position, light/dark) right from WordPress. Changes are saved to your assistant in Zeronode.
  • Connect your WooCommerce store so the assistant can look up products, prices and stock.
  • Let the assistant act in your store: add products to the visitor’s cart, apply coupons, open product, cart and checkout pages. Visitors confirm each action; switch it off to keep the assistant advisory only.

The chat widget runs in an isolated Shadow DOM, so it does not clash with your theme’s styles. It is not loaded on your checkout, pay-for-order or add-payment-method pages.

This plugin needs a Zeronode account (https://zeronode.ai).

External services

This plugin is a connector for Zeronode (https://zeronode.ai), a hosted AI chat assistant service. It does not work without a Zeronode account, and it talks to Zeronode’s servers as described here.

Zeronode API (https://api.zeronode.ai), called from your site’s server (never from the visitor’s browser) when a site administrator uses the settings screen:

  • Signing in: your Zeronode account email and the one-time code you received are sent to obtain an account token. The token is stored in your site’s database (option zeronode_account, not autoloaded), encrypted with a key derived from your site’s own secret keys, and is never sent to visitors or to your browser. With an embed key (zn_pub_) instead, the key is sent once to check that Zeronode knows it, then only printed on your public pages for the widget.
  • Choosing and configuring an assistant: your site’s address (to create an embed key locked to it), the appearance settings you save (title, colours, picture URL, corners, position, light/dark), the voice note, your checkout page address, and which store actions the assistant may use.
  • Connecting a store: the store’s address and a WooCommerce REST API consumer key and secret. The keys are stored on your assistant in Zeronode, not in WordPress. Please note that a WooCommerce REST API key with Read permission can read everything its WordPress user can read through the WooCommerce API, which includes orders and customers as well as products; Zeronode uses it to read your product catalogue. “Connect this store” creates such a key for you (named “Zeronode AI Chat Assistant” in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API); disconnecting the store or deleting the plugin removes it.
  • Knowledge: the addresses of pages you ask the assistant to read.

Zeronode widget and chat backend (https://content.zeronode.ai, https://api.zeronode.ai, wss://api.zeronode.ai), used in the visitor’s browser on your public pages while the assistant is turned on:

  • The chat widget script is part of the Zeronode service and is loaded from Zeronode’s servers, so it is always the current version of the service. If your assistant has store actions of its own set up in Zeronode, the widget loads that script from Zeronode’s servers too. The plugin does not store or print any code received from Zeronode.
  • On each public page where the assistant is shown, the widget opens a connection to Zeronode when the page loads. As with any web request, Zeronode sees the visitor’s IP address; the widget also sends your public embed key, your site’s address and the browser’s language.
  • While the visitor browses, the widget may send the page they are on, the pages they viewed during this visit and usage events of the widget itself (for example that a greeting was shown or dismissed), so the assistant can offer help at a fitting moment. Nothing is stored on the visitor’s device until they use the assistant.
  • When a visitor uses the chat, their messages and a browser-generated conversation id are sent to Zeronode to generate replies. From then on the conversation id and the conversation are kept in the browser’s local storage, so the chat continues from page to page.
  • Only the public, site-locked embed key is placed on your pages.
  • The chat window, which is drawn by the Zeronode service and not by this plugin, shows a small “Powered by zeronode.ai” link under the message box.

Terms of service: https://zeronode.ai/terms
Privacy policy: https://zeronode.ai/privacy

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload its ZIP there.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Settings > Zeronode Assistant.
  4. Enter your account email, type in the code you receive, choose your assistant, and save. Or choose “Use an embed key instead” and paste the key from the assistant’s Embed tab in Zeronode.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Zeronode account?

Yes. The plugin puts an assistant from your existing Zeronode account on your site.

Where do the colours and title come from?

They live on your assistant in Zeronode. Editing them here saves them back to your assistant, so they stay consistent everywhere it runs.

Why does the assistant not show on my checkout page?

On purpose. Pages where visitors type payment details (checkout, pay for order, add payment method) load no script from outside your shop, the assistant included.

I installed an earlier version from a ZIP file, called Zeronode Web Agent. What now?

Delete that plugin first, then install this one. Deleting it clears its settings on this site, so sign in again or paste your embed key. Your assistant in Zeronode is unchanged.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Its settings are removed from your site’s database, and so is the WooCommerce REST API key it created, if it created one. Your assistant and its settings stay in your Zeronode account.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • The plugin is now called Zeronode AI Chat Assistant (it was Zeronode Web Agent).
  • The assistant is no longer loaded on checkout, pay-for-order and add-payment-method pages.
  • Sign-in is by one-time email code only; the password option is gone.
  • The account token is stored encrypted.
  • Store actions set up in Zeronode are loaded by the widget itself; the plugin no longer stores or prints that code.
  • Deleting the plugin also removes the WooCommerce REST API key it created.
  • Notices from WordPress and other plugins show above the settings panel again.
  • The settings screen can be translated.

1.0.0

  • First stable release.
  • Put the assistant on the site with its embed key alone, without signing in; it is then configured in Zeronode.
  • Connect a WooCommerce store (this site’s or another) so the assistant can look up products.
  • Sign-in form layout fix.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: email-code sign-in, agent picker, automatic site-locked embed key, and basic appearance settings.
